# A river gunboat, 0.7 x 1.9 m: a grey hull with a pointed bow (front -Y), a red bow stripe, a cream cabin and a funnel; its turret is a separate piece (turret.txt). Pivot at the waterline centre.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Metal --base-color 0.408 0.298 0.235 --no-slot
material new Steel --base-color 0.573 0.494 0.416 --no-slot
material new Wall --base-color 0.937 0.847 0.631 --no-slot
material new Dark --base-color 0.224 0.165 0.110 --no-slot
material new Roof --base-color 0.608 0.102 0.039 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Hull --size 1 --location 0 0.1 0.05
scale 0.72 1.6 0.3
apply --scale
select Hull
active Hull
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
material assign Metal
add mesh cube --name Bow --size 1 --location 0 -0.85 0.05
scale 0.72 0.3 0.3
apply --scale
select Bow
active Bow
mode edit
select vert where "pos.y < 0"
scale 0.15 1 1
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
material assign Roof
add mesh cube --name Cabin1 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.350 0.330
scale 0.460 0.550 0.260
apply --scale
select Cabin1
active Cabin1
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Cabin1
material assign Wall
add mesh cylinder --name Funnel --vertices 6 --radius 0.1 --depth 0.3 --location 0 0.72 0.35
material assign Dark
select all
shade flat
export boat.glb
